testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-account-sync.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-31717 admin overrides a user sales rep after account synchronization

scenario.summary: An account with sales rep A and a user under it synchronized to rep A; the admin assigns sales rep B to the user on Manage User and saves; the user's sales rep is rep B.
steps: Go to Accounts and Users > Users; search the user (@user.userName) and open Manage User.
Check the Sales Rep is @repA.fullName; click the Sales Rep search icon, search @repB.fullName and select it; save.
Reopen Manage User of the user; read the Sales Rep.
stateChanges: Changes the user's Sales Rep from @repA to @repB (the user is deleted at teardown).
assertions: Before the change the user's Sales Rep is @repA.fullName
After saving, the user's Sales Rep is @repB.fullName
evidence: Story Z10-38546 (SalesRep - Phase 2, account association), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-38546/analysis.md sections 3-4 and answers in section 6.
FSD section 7 (Important Point: the account's rep overwrites the user's on association; administrators can then override it on Manage User) and section 8 (user rep > account rep).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A), as in the Phase 1 tests.
ACCOUNT_OF_STORE, CHILD_ACCOUNT_OF_ACCOUNT and USER_OF_ACCOUNT are new consumable keys (analysis section 4, pending approval; collections still to build through the account and customer APIs).
Sales reps A and B are both reps of store A (the user's store), so B is in the Manage User popup (Phase 1 store rule).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
